transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m here because I’m tired all the time. By midmorning at work, even just reviewing files or helping a junior adjuster with a claim, I feel like my body and my brain are already running on empty.
Aside from feeling tired, how has your mood been recently?

Most days, honestly, it feels like there’s this gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being kind or we’re cooking with the family, I go through the motions, but I don’t really feel the enjoyment I used to.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About three years and three months now. It started around when I was moved into the higher-responsibility role—mentoring adjusters and overseeing the new workflow systems.
During these past three years, have you had any periods lasting more than a couple of months where your mood and energy returned to normal?
No, I can’t think of a stretch that long where I felt back to normal. It’s been pretty steady since I took on that higher-responsibility role, about three years and three months ago.
During these three years, have there been any periods lasting at least two weeks where the depression became noticeably worse than your usual baseline?
I’m not really sure. It’s felt pretty consistently low, but I can’t point to a two-week period where it clearly got worse than usual.
Have you ever had a period where you felt the complete opposite—unusually energized, euphoric, or wired for days without needing much sleep?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that.
